messages:
Asha (SRE): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring short p95 spikes during peak that pushed p95 to ~1.6s for 5-12m windows. Need owners, a narrow SLO safety plan, and action tracking.

Ben (Platform): Agree. Two parallel tracks: immediate mitigation (2% canary to quantized variants + per-key soft rate-limit) and medium-term fixes (cache TTL stabilization, request shaping).

Ravi (Service Owner): For enterprise tenants we must avoid silent degradation. Can we scope any degradation to labeled public keys only?

Mina (Product): Yes. Product will produce an enterprise/non-enterprise mapping and a comms stub. Also we want a dashboard that shows per-tenant burn-rate and top callers CSV.

Asha (SRE): Proposal: temporary safety window 14 days: public-hosted p95 <= 320ms (was 200ms), applied only to non-enterprise keys. Pause non-critical rollouts if 72h burn-rate > 1.3. Keep p99 unchanged. Prefer graceful degradation over loosening SLAs.

Ben (Platform): Implementation plan: label-based routing + 2% quantized fallback for public keys today; expand to 10% if 24h burn-rate > 1.5. I'll add per-key soft rate-limits for top callers.

Ravi (Service Owner): I'll draft the degradation policy for /generate and /embed (which features to reduce) and mark which endpoints are enterprise-exempt. ETA 48h.

Asha (SRE): Action items: - Asha: add p95 burn-rate alert + playbook snippet to dashboard (today) - Ben: implement 2% canary + label routing (today) - Ravi: degradation policy + enterprise exemptions (2d) - Mina: customer comms + enterprise mapping (tomorrow)

ops-bot: Created calendar event "SLO remediation checkpoint" Mon 09:30 PT and alert rule p95 burn-rate > 1.2 -> notify #eng-platform + oncall.

Ben (Platform): Dashboard PR includes PromQL: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, api_key, route)) and top callers: topk(10, sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (api_key)). Link draft: https://dash.redwoodinternal.com/d/latency/slo-playbook (panel id: p95-burn).

Asha (SRE): Added runbook snippet: on short spike -> check escrow/label -> prefer degraded route for public keys -> notify owners -> run 24h mitigation -> revert if stable. Also added CSV export for top callers.

Mina (Product): I'll post the comms draft to #customer-ops and tag Sales for enterprise confirmations.

Ravi (Service Owner): Noted. I'll coordinate with Ben on safe rollout and test plan to ensure enterprise keys are unaffected.

Asha (SRE): We'll reconvene after 24h mitigation window to review error-budget trend. If mitigation doesn't reduce burn, escalate permanent fixes (edge shaping, batching). Update the tracker with owner+due dates.

Ben (Platform): PR opened for routing changes: https://git.internal/routing/PR-1201. Feedback welcome.

Mina (Product): Thanks all, follow-up update in this thread EOD tomorrow."
